## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e73e6d45bc6bf715a2cf91f7ec5bdf7aed92b247`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectui/evals/data-integration.json, skills/objectui/guides/auth-permissions.md, skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md + ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts, packages/client/src/index.ts, ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts, ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthenticatedFetch.ts, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/connectBaseUrlApiSuffix-27774.test.ts, ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs

Inputs: card #27774 (body, triage 6510453993, claim 6515328969, dev report 6515829241), PR #27967 body and file list (7 files, +143/−43), the net diff `origin/main...e73e6d45` (merge base `ed0e71db`), and the 54 check-runs on the head. The rest of the diff (`.changeset/27774-adapter-base-url-origin.md`, `ui/packages/data-objectstack/README.md`, the new pin, `index.ts`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; `index.ts` and the pin were READ here to judge the skill, never reviewed.

**Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-10-30T05:49Z:** 54 total — 32 success, 8 skipped, 13 in progress (Test UI 1/3/5/6/7/9/10/11/12/13/16 of 16, Test Core 1/8, Type Check UI), **1 failure: `Test UI (2/16)`**. Its annotation names `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/column-width-config-retired-10582.test.ts:113` failing with `ENOENT … ui/packages/cli/tsup.config.bundled_f5hi2m4wg4d.mjs` — a tree walk that stat'ed a tsup temp file another package's build deleted under it. No path of this diff is under `ui/packages/types` or `ui/packages/cli`; the failure is a race in the shard, not this change, and a rerun is owed before landing. The governed gates that answer this review's families are green: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Type Check · source/consumer/workspace/debt`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build UI Deps`, `Live E2E UI`. The landing precondition "every check green" is NOT met at this reading; this record judges the design, and the seat re-reads the head before it lands.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl })` now reads a value ending in `/api/vN` (and a trailing slash) as the server origin** (`serverOriginOf`, `index.ts:948`), once, before the wrapped `ObjectStackClient` is built — the tolerance arm of the card's two options, which is the arm the triage ruled ("strips a trailing `/api/vN` the same way its search, data, export and meta paths already do, so both spellings work. Pin both spellings"). Right. The accept set the package DECLARED did not move: its README and four of its own reads already accepted that spelling on `main`; the two sites that disagreed (discovery, the client) now agree with them.
2. **The client and `RealtimeAPI` receive the origin, not the raw value.** `ObjectStackClient` only strips a trailing slash (`packages/client/src/index.ts:1704`) and joins absolute `/api/v1/...` routes onto its base (`:1733`, `:1854` ff.), so a discovery-only strip would have connected and then doubled every client-routed read; the constructor placement is the right one and the pin's last case (`listMetadataItems` → `/api/v1/meta/position` once) reads exactly that. Right — the PR's "mechanism assumption re-measured" is confirmed from source.
3. **The five per-call `hasApiVersionSuffix` branches are gone; every raw read joins `/api/v1/...` onto the origin.** For the origin form the URL bytes are identical to `main`; for the suffixed form they are now the same URLs. The approvals reads (`:7297`, `:7322`), the analytics query (`:6875`) and the two unversioned upload sites (`:7165`, `:7227`, `/api/data/.../upload`, pre-existing shape, not reviewed) join onto the same value. Right.
4. **The shared discovery cache is keyed by the origin** (`getSharedDiscovery(baseUrl)`, the empty origin keyed by a fixed default token), so `''` and `'/api/v1'` on one page share one read. Right.
5. **The skill's taught form moves from `'/api/v1'` to `''` at all five adapter sites** (data-integration.md :133 with the two forms named, :155, :207 constructor comment, :218, :462; auth-permissions.md :136), and `evals/data-integration.json` eval 2 refuses `baseUrl: '/api/v1`. `git grep -n "baseUrl: '/api/v1'" -- skills` is 0 hits on the head — the card's acceptance line. Right.
6. **No public type surface moves**: the constructor option stays `baseUrl: string` (a doc comment is added); no `packages/spec`, no governed-register row, no `ui/` type the Console compiles against changes. `Type Check UI` is still running; `Type Check · workspace` and `TypeScript Type Check` are green.
7. **Left standing, by the dev's choice and agreed here:** `MetadataClient` keeps its own suffix strip (`metadata-client.ts:812`) and its README examples; `project-setup.md:324` keeps `VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api/v1` as an unwired env example. Both work on this tree.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/27774-adapter-base-url-origin.md`: `@object-ui/data-objectstack: patch`, `@objectstack/skills: patch`; `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none`; the PR body carries the same two lines. Matches the diff: a bug fix inside an accept set the package already declared (README, four sibling reads), no new export, no changed option type, no metadata-author surface. `Clause-②: no` holds — had the triage picked the card's other arm (refuse a `/api/vN` base with a named error) this would have been `yes (narrowing)` and BREAKING; it did not. `@objectstack/skills` publishes the skill text, so a changeset is owed there too and `skip-changeset` would have been wrong. `Check Changeset` is green. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions[0]` — report comment first line (os-dev.md says the bare `os-dev-report` marker is line 1; `post-stamped.mjs` refuses a body whose first non-empty line is not the seat signature).** Read both: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:17` does say 首行单独一行是纯文本 `os-dev-report`; `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs:468` ("The first line is the seat's signature, or the body is refused") does refuse it. The conflict is real. **A (marker on line 2) was right for this PR**: the readers skip one signature line (`stripSignatureLine`), and this brief located the report by its SECOND line. **B is escalated, not answered here**: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` is a governed `.claude/**` path (Tier S) and outside this card; the next seat that touches the playbook amends the clause to "signature first, marker second". Not blocking.
- **`out_of_scope_findings[3]` — declared-surface deviation, `guides/auth-permissions.md` edited (one line).** Accepted: the card's acceptance is a grep over `skills`, this is its fifth hit, the same governed bundle and tier, and no other claim holds the file. It is in `hits` and judged in ④.
- **`out_of_scope_findings[0]` — `project-setup.md:324` `VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api/v1`.** Agreed, not a defect: the value is an env example, never wired to the adapter, and a reader who does wire it gets the spelling the adapter now tolerates. No card.
- **`out_of_scope_findings[1]` — README `MetadataClient` examples keep `'/api/v1'`.** Agreed: a different class with its own strip (`metadata-client.ts:812-813`). No card.
- **`out_of_scope_findings[2]` — approvals and analytics reads.** Agreed from source (`index.ts:6875`, `:7297`, `:7322`): they join onto the normalised origin now; the analytics local trim was dead code after the constructor change.
- **Added by this review, same class as the README note:** `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthenticatedFetch.ts:76-78`, the function's own JSDoc example, still teaches `new ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl: '/api/v1', fetch: authenticatedFetch })`. It works on this tree by the same tolerance; it is a doc comment outside the skill, outside this PR's claim, and not a defect. Noted for the next edit of that file; no card.
- **Not a dev flag — the check-run reading above:** `Test UI (2/16)` red on an unrelated tsup temp-file race; rerun before landing.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`** — five hunks, judged against the card's eval prompt and the adapter on `main` plus this PR.
- `baseUrl: ''` is right in every snippet's context. On `main` `''` already reached `/api/v1/discovery` (discovery branch `baseUrl ? … : '/api/v1/discovery'`) and every client route (`''.replace(/\/$/, '')` → `''`, then `/api/v1/...`); on this PR `serverOriginOf('')` → `''` and the same URLs. Nothing the guide taught that worked stops working; the one thing that did not (client-routed reads from `'/api/v1'`) now does, and the guide no longer teaches it.
- **The auth snippet (:151-157)**: `createAuthClient({ baseURL: '/api/v1/auth' })` beside `baseUrl: ''` is consistent — both are same-origin spellings, and that is the shape the Console itself passes: `App.tsx:105-106` hands the adapter `VITE_SERVER_URL || ''` and builds the auth URL as `${SERVER_URL}/api/v1/auth`, so the two values move together. **A non-proxied deployment** writes `baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com'` and `baseURL: 'https://api.example.com/api/v1/auth'`; the first snippet's comment (:133, "the server ORIGIN: '' behind a same-origin proxy, or 'https://api.example.com'") and the constructor-options comment (:207, "Server origin ('' = same origin); the adapter adds /api/v1") name that form, and "the adapter adds /api/v1" is true of every URL it builds (discovery, search, data, export, meta, analytics, approvals) and of the client's routes.
- **should-fix (one voice), not blocking:** the `os:check` "Test DataSource helper" at :388 keeps a third spelling, `new ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl: '/' })`. It works on both trees (the client and `serverOriginOf` each strip the slash to `''`), so it is not a defect, but the guide now explains `''` and the origin and leaves `'/'` unexplained two sections later; the next edit of this file makes it `''`. Token headroom is 123 (4328/4451).
- Observation outside this PR's hunk: the same auth snippet calls `createAuthenticatedFetch(authClient)` while the function takes an options object (`createAuthenticatedFetch(options?: CreateAuthenticatedFetchOptions)`, `createAuthenticatedFetch.ts:82`); auth-permissions.md:133 calls it with no argument. Pre-existing on `main`, not this PR's claim, and the block is not an `os:check` fence so no gate reads it; a card for the `domain:skills` lane if it wants it, not a finding here.

**`skills/objectui/guides/auth-permissions.md`** — one hunk (:136). Holds: the surrounding section is same-origin throughout (`createAuthClient({ baseURL: '/api/v1/auth' })` at :25 and :132, `authUrl="/api/v1/auth"` at :29), so `''` is the matching adapter value, and the Console passes exactly this pair. The explanatory comment that data-integration.md:133 carries was dropped here to stay under the file's ratchet ceiling (3864 of 3866, headroom was 0); acceptable because the reader loads the bundle and `SKILL.md` routes data wiring to data-integration.md, where the two forms are named twice. Accepted, no finding.

**`skills/objectui/evals/data-integration.json`** — eval 2.
- `must_not_contain: "baseUrl: '/api/v1"` **holds and avoids false positives.** It refuses `baseUrl: '/api/v1'` and `baseUrl: '/api/v1/'` (the prefix is deliberate, so the acceptance grep's shape is refused with any tail). Under the substring, case-sensitive match the repo's eval gates describe (`check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`, "accidental substring"), it does NOT match `createAuthClient({ baseURL: '/api/v1/auth' })` (differs at `URL`/`Url`), the Vite proxy block (`'/api': { target: … }`), `baseUrl: ''`, or `baseUrl: 'http://localhost:3000'`. No guide in the bundle spells the string at this head (grep: 0 hits), so an answer that follows the skill is never refused for restating a rule it follows — the objectui#7370 pitfall the eval-tokens gate documents is avoided — and the `expected_output` does not spell it either (the 27455 self-agreement). Holes, not false positives: a double-quoted `"/api/v1"` or an absolute `'http://localhost:3000/api/v1'` pass the refusal; the first is not a form the skill's single-quoted examples invite, the second now works. Acceptable.
- The rewritten `expected_output` ("Runs the server with os dev (Todo in objectstack.config), proxies /api from Vite, hands ObjectStackAdapter the origin ''; no MSW.") **still matches its prompt** ("build my ObjectUI frontend before the backend is deployed … how do I get a working API locally?"): the guide's "Frontend-first development" section (:353-370) teaches exactly `os dev` plus the Vite `/api` proxy, and the adapter wiring on the same origin is the half of that answer the eval now checks. `must_contain` (`os dev`, `proxy`, `objectstack.config`) is unchanged and every token is taught; the eval-tokens gate is in the green `Lint · docs & code guards` family.
- Budget: 470 of 471 ratchet tokens — one token of headroom; the next edit to this file pays in the same file.

**Tried to break the design (cited code, read not reviewed):** `serverOriginOf` strips ONE trailing slash then `/api/vN`; `'/api/v1//'` would survive as `/api/v1/` and double — not a taught form, and the client strips one slash too. A server really mounted under a `/api/v1` path prefix can no longer be addressed by that prefix — the four sibling reads already made that choice on `main`, and the skill teaches the origin. `/api/v2` is read as the origin and routed to `/api/v1/...` — the siblings' regex, no v2 API exists; the dev's note is right. The pin's fake fetch answers any URL ending in `/api/v1/discovery`, so on the red leg `connect()` resolved and the URL assertion was the failing one — a looser fake than it could be, but the pin reads the URL the fetch received, which is the claim. No must-fix.

**Findings:** should-fix ×1 (data-integration.md:388 `'/'` spelling). Must-fix: none.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`ObjectStackAdapter` 在构造时把 `baseUrl` 统一归一成服务器源（去掉末尾的 `/` 和 `/api/vN`）。内嵌的 `ObjectStackClient` 和适配器自己的各个裸请求共用这个源，五处各自判断后缀的代码删掉了。同时，`objectui` skill 和包 README 改为教源写法：同源代理下写 `''`，否则写服务器地址。
- **为什么改**：skill 一直教 `baseUrl: '/api/v1'`，按这个写，发现请求会变成 `/api/v1/api/v1/discovery`，`connect()` 失败，之后所有读写跟着失败（#27774）。分诊裁定平台优先：两种写法都要能用。
- **风险与回滚**：只有带 `/api/vN` 后缀的 baseUrl 行为会变（从坏的变成能用）；`''` 和源写法的 URL 一个字节都不变，有 7 条钉子测试覆盖。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 里的 `serverOriginOf` 和构造函数；`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` 的四处改动。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/src/connectBaseUrlApiSuffix-27774.test.ts`，预期 7 条全部通过（在 main 上是 4 红 3 绿）。
- **需要你做的**：Tier H（`skills/**`），请审阅并批准。合约复核 PASS 见评论 6515998431，`Head-sha` 为 `e73e6d45bc6bf715a2cf91f7ec5bdf7aed92b247`。

**席位意见**：建议批准。dev 实测证伪了「只改发现那一行」的假设：client 也会让路由翻倍，所以把归一提前到构造函数，这和分诊的裁定是同一个方向。合约复核留了一条非阻塞的 should-fix：指南第 388 行还写着 `baseUrl: '/'`，这个写法能用，等这个文件下次修改时顺手改掉。

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · head `e73e6d45bc6bf715a2cf91f7ec5bdf7aed92b247` · 2026-10-30T06:18Z

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #27774`. `Clause-②: no` (a bug fix inside an accept set the package already declared) and `Metadata-protocol: none` match the claim. Changeset: patch for `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@objectstack/skills`.
- **Ruling (triage 6510453993):** platform first, one PR, cross-domain exception, Tier H. The adapter accepts both spellings and the skill teaches the origin form. Both are done. The serial predecessor PR #27764 merged first.
- **Premise, measured:** the order assumed a one-line fix in discovery. The dev disproved it: `ObjectStackClient` joins `/api/v1/...` onto its base as given, so the client's routes double as well. The normalisation therefore sits once in the constructor (`serverOriginOf`), shared by the client and every raw read, and the five per-call suffix checks are gone. The adapter's `baseUrl` field is private, and `MetadataClient` gets the normalised value too.
- **Tests:** `connectBaseUrlApiSuffix-27774` is 4 red / 3 green on `main` and 7 green on the head. The whole package passes (104 files, 1228 tests), and type-check exits 0.
- **Contract review:** PASS on this head, comment 6515998431 (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, scope = the three `skills/**` hits + cited code). It has no must-fix. One should-fix is left for the file's next edit: guide `:388` `baseUrl: '/'`, which works.
- **Gates (check-runs on the head):** 48 success, 8 skipped, 0 failure. `Test UI (2/16)` was a tsup temp-file ENOENT race unrelated to the diff; it was re-run once (run 41009153397, attempt 2) and passed. `mergeable_state` clean. `check-governed-merges --pr 27967`: GOVERNED, `skills/**` ×3, Tier H, 186 changed lines.
- **Accepted deviations:**
  - `guides/auth-permissions.md`, the same defect and the fifth acceptance-grep hit, is outside the declared surface.
  - The package README was taught the same way.
  - The report's signature-first line follows post-stamped, as noted in its open question.
- **Out of scope:** the `createAuthenticatedFetch` JSDoc still shows `/api/v1`, which works after this PR. The guide's `createAuthenticatedFetch(authClient)` call shape predates this PR.
